content.short: Entropy Advisors is an onchain research and strategy firm, known for its work with the Arbitrum DAO.
content.description: Entropy Advisors turns on-chain data into strategy work for protocols and DAOs, most visibly through its engagement with the Arbitrum ecosystem. Robinhood's chain documentation lists it among the analytics providers maintaining dashboards for Robinhood Chain, which is a natural fit given that the chain is built on Arbitrum's stack. Its output sits closer to advisory work than to a self-serve analytics product.
content.meta: Entropy Advisors is an onchain research and strategy firm working with Arbitrum and Robinhood Chain.
